cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Confess Around Them
cards.instruction: Use partial admissions to make a reciprocal confession feel like the only missing piece.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I kept the first complaint letter in my drawer. Put that down before we discuss the second one.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: So you knew the customers were complaining.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I knew about the first letter. Please record that precisely; I've put it on the table. Which drawer should we check for the next one?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: There was a third letter. It went straight to me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then put it after mine, please. You've given us the destination; now give us what you did with it. The middle envelope can wait until we've finished those two admissions.
